# LethalPirateClark

A Backrooms creature. He doesn't chase. He waits. When you look away, he moves. When you look back, he stops.

Pirate Clark is a Lethal Company enemy mod based on the *Backrooms: Still Life* entity from Kane Pixels' series.

## Install

Use [Thunderstore Mod Manager](https://www.overwolf.com/app/Thunderstore-Thunderstore_Mod_Manager) or [r2modman](https://thunderstore.io/c/lethal-company/p/ebkr/r2modman/) and search for **LethalPirateClark**.

**Manual install:** drop the contents of `plugins/LethalPirateClark/` into your `Lethal Company/BepInEx/plugins/LethalPirateClark/` folder.

## Dependencies (installed automatically by the mod manager)

- [BepInExPack](https://thunderstore.io/c/lethal-company/p/BepInEx/BepInExPack/) 5.4.2100+
- [LethalLib](https://thunderstore.io/c/lethal-company/p/Evaisa/LethalLib/) 0.16.0+

See https://github.com/TESTYEE-09/LethalPirateClark for configuration, the model attribution, and the full changelog.
